# ex: function signature mismatch via tuple length difference exercises identical() tuple path
ex {
	var f func(int) int
	f(1) -> f(1) + 1
}
-- x.go --
package p

func g(x int) int          { return x }
func h(x, y int) int       { return x + y }

var _ = g(1)
var _ = h(1, 2)
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 package p

-func g(x int) int          { return x }
-func h(x, y int) int       { return x + y }
+func g(x int) int    { return x }
+func h(x, y int) int { return x + y }

-var _ = g(1)
+var _ = g(1) + 1
 var _ = h(1, 2)
